quotes.text: Privacy is not a luxury; it is a weapon.
If it's not permissionless, it's a prison.
Software eats the law while the lawyers are sleeping.
Exit is the ultimate form of voice.
Build things that make governments obsolete.
Your comfort zone is a subsidized hallucination.
The most radical thing you can do is be self-sufficient.
Bureaucracy is the art of making the possible impossible.
Code is the only constitution that doesn't require an interpreter.
Taxation is the subscription fee for a service you can't cancel.
The network state begins in your group chat.
Fiat is a slow-motion rug pull.
Regulations are just moat-building for the uninspired.
Don't ask for permission. Ask for forgiveness. Or just be anonymous.
A ship in harbor is safe, but that's not what ships are built for. Also, the harbor is taxed.
Opting out is the only way to win a rigged game.
Centralization is a single point of failure for humanity.
Your 9-to-5 is a bribe to forget your dreams.
Decentralize everything until nothing is too big to fail.
The future is here, it’s just not encrypted yet.
Consistency is the last refuge of the unimaginative.
The state is a legacy system that refuses to reboot.
Capitalism is the only system that turns self-interest into social utility.
Anonymity is the digital equivalent of the right to bear arms.
Irony is the only armor that survives the internet.
Post-rationality is just gut feeling with better vocabulary.
Every regulation is a business plan for the black market.
The best way to predict the future is to ship it.
Sincerity is the new counter-culture.
If you aren't being cancelled at least once a year, you aren't saying anything.
